parts.name: casting

physics.Basic_description: The main dark grey matte body of the plane, appearing as a robust cast metal structure with machined surfaces.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the structural framework and reference surfaces for all other components.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the main body from the sides or top to stabilize the tool during use or transport.
physics.reason: Cast plane bodies contain internal voids and ribbing to reduce weight; treating as solid would overestimate mass significantly.

parts.description: The main dark grey matte body of the plane, appearing as a robust cast metal structure with machined surfaces.
parts.function: Provides the structural framework and reference surfaces for all other components.

parts.name: sole edge

physics.Basic_description: The flat bottom edge of the plane body, visible as a thin strip in the side view.
physics.Functional_description: The reference surface that slides against the workpiece to ensure flatness.
physics.Grasped_description: Not a grasp target; avoid contacting the precision sole surface.
physics.reason: The sole is a thick, machined section of the casting intended to wear evenly.

parts.description: The flat bottom edge of the plane body, visible as a thin strip in the side view.
parts.function: The reference surface that slides against the workpiece to ensure flatness.

parts.name: frog

physics.Basic_description: An angled internal platform within the body mouth, dark grey metal.
physics.Functional_description: Supports the cutting iron at the correct angle and allows for lateral adjustment.
physics.Grasped_description: Internal component, not accessible for grasping during normal operation.
physics.reason: The frog is a solid block of metal machined to precise angles.

parts.description: An angled internal platform within the body mouth, dark grey metal.
parts.function: Supports the cutting iron at the correct angle and allows for lateral adjustment.

parts.name: palm heel boss

physics.Basic_description: A raised circular platform at the rear of the plane body, dark grey.
physics.Functional_description: Provides a mounting point or resting surface for the palm at the rear of the tool.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be pressed against by the palm or gripped from the rear to push the plane.
physics.reason: Likely a solid extension of the casting or a thick-walled boss.

parts.description: A raised circular platform at the rear of the plane body, dark grey.
parts.function: Provides a mounting point or resting surface for the palm at the rear of the tool.

parts.name: depth stud

physics.Basic_description: A small threaded metal rod protruding from the body, silver/grey.
physics.Functional_description: Engages with the depth adjustment mechanism to control cut depth.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and internal to grasp directly; manipulated via the wheel.

parts.description: A small threaded metal rod protruding from the body, silver/grey.
parts.function: Engages with the depth adjustment mechanism to control cut depth.

parts.name: thumbscrew stud

physics.Basic_description: A threaded metal post for the clamp lever, silver/grey.
physics.Functional_description: Secures the lever cap and cutting iron assembly to the frog.
physics.Grasped_description: Not a grasp target; interacted with via the thumbscrew.

parts.description: A threaded metal post for the clamp lever, silver/grey.
parts.function: Secures the lever cap and cutting iron assembly to the frog.

parts.name: clamp boss 0

physics.Basic_description: Small raised mounting points on the body, dark grey.
physics.Functional_description: Provide structural support for the clamping mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and integrated to grasp independently.

parts.description: Small raised mounting points on the body, dark grey.
parts.function: Provide structural support for the clamping mechanism.

parts.name: clamp boss 1

physics.Basic_description: Small raised mounting points on the body, dark grey.
physics.Functional_description: Provide structural support for the clamping mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and integrated to grasp independently.

parts.description: Small raised mounting points on the body, dark grey.
parts.function: Provide structural support for the clamping mechanism.

parts.name: iron

physics.Basic_description: A sharp, flat silver/white metal blade angled upwards from the body.
physics.Functional_description: The primary cutting edge that removes material from the workpiece.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the upper exposed portion of the blade carefully to adjust or remove it.

parts.description: A sharp, flat silver/white metal blade angled upwards from the body.
parts.function: The primary cutting edge that removes material from the workpiece.

parts.name: bar

physics.Basic_description: A silver/white metal bar or lever cap securing the blade.
physics.Functional_description: Applies pressure to hold the cutting iron firmly against the frog.
physics.Grasped_description: Usually manipulated via the thumbscrew rather than grasped directly.

parts.description: A silver/white metal bar or lever cap securing the blade.
parts.function: Applies pressure to hold the cutting iron firmly against the frog.

parts.name: screw

physics.Basic_description: A knurled yellow/gold brass knob used for tightening.
physics.Functional_description: Allows the user to lock or release the cutting iron assembly by hand.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the knurled sides with fingertips to rotate and tighten/loosen.

parts.description: A knurled yellow/gold brass knob used for tightening.
parts.function: Allows the user to lock or release the cutting iron assembly by hand.

parts.name: hump

physics.Basic_description: A smooth, reddish-brown curved insert at the front of the plane.
physics.Functional_description: Provides a comfortable, non-slip surface for the user's leading hand.
physics.Grasped_description: Press the palm or fingers against this curved surface to guide the plane.

parts.description: A smooth, reddish-brown curved insert at the front of the plane.
parts.function: Provides a comfortable, non-slip surface for the user's leading hand.

parts.name: lever

physics.Basic_description: A thin silver/white metal lever protruding from the blade assembly.
physics.Functional_description: Adjusts the lateral alignment of the cutting edge relative to the sole.
physics.Grasped_description: Pinch the end of the lever with fingertips to shift the blade left or right.

parts.description: A thin silver/white metal lever protruding from the blade assembly.
parts.function: Adjusts the lateral alignment of the cutting edge relative to the sole.

parts.name: wheel

physics.Basic_description: A knurled yellow/gold brass wheel located near the rear of the mouth.
physics.Functional_description: Rotates to raise or lower the cutting iron for precise depth control.
physics.Grasped_description: Roll the wheel with a thumb or finger to adjust the cut depth.

parts.description: A knurled yellow/gold brass wheel located near the rear of the mouth.
parts.function: Rotates to raise or lower the cutting iron for precise depth control.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
